---
description: The lines shown in the chat's thinking block while a turn is being worked on. One kind of line per row, a name, a colon, then its text. Change the words freely. Delete a row and that kind of line is no longer shown. The row named still is the one that keeps a long silent turn alive; without it, the chat application may give up on a turn that shows nothing for long.
format: lines
---
started: Reading the turn.
tool: {{tool}}
rule: A rule of yours fired: {{rule}}.
writing: Writing.
still: Still working ({{elapsed}}).
